title: Basic Science practice
subject: basic_science

review: Sample: to be reviewed by a Basic Science teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: What is the basic unit of life?
questions.explanation: All living things are made of cells.

questions.question: Which part of a cell controls its activities?
questions.explanation: The nucleus controls the cell's activities.

questions.question: At what temperature does pure water boil at sea level?
questions.explanation: Pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.

questions.question: Which of these is a renewable source of energy?
questions.explanation: Sunlight does not run out, so solar energy is renewable.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of water?
questions.explanation: Water is H2O: two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.question: Which blood vessels carry blood away from the heart?
questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart.

questions.question: Which force pulls objects towards the earth?
questions.explanation: Gravity pulls objects towards the earth.

questions.question: In which part of a plant does most photosynthesis happen?
questions.explanation: Most photosynthesis happens in the leaves.

questions.question: Which of these is a mixture?
questions.explanation: Air is a mixture of gases. Water is a compound.
